prompt:
Build an open electric-aircraft mission and powertrain plant in Simulink/Simscape. Couple a height-based flight-cycle command, an aerodynamic aircraft load with lift and drag, thrust and propeller/load-torque conversion, a controlled electric motor and drive, a high-voltage battery, DC conversion and distribution, and switched low-voltage lamp, heater, and avionics loads. The plant must use finite aircraft and battery mass so that battery capacity and payload both affect the required power and achievable mission range. This is not an autopilot task: do not claim or fabricate a flight-control computer, nonlinear-dynamic-inversion controller, or closed-loop flight-path controller.

Read aircraft_design_input from the MATLAB base workspace. battery_capacity_Ah is in 100--160 A*h and payload_mass_kg is in 0--80 kg. Use the published fixed lower-altitude flight profile and component constants. Treat the requested profile as the mission/load demand followed by the open plant. Stop when the battery reaches the plant's discharge boundary or at 8000 s. Capacity must influence stored energy and battery mass; payload must influence aircraft mass and aerodynamic/mechanical power demand. Both inputs must cause material, causal changes in flight duration, distance, battery response, or motor current. Prescribed range, replayed battery trajectories, and disconnected electrical or aerodynamic paths are invalid.

Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named flight_distance, battery_state, motor_current, and low_voltage_load_power. flight_distance has width 1: mission distance (km). battery_state has width 3 in this order: remaining charge (A*h), terminal voltage (V), and battery current (A). motor_current has width 1: motor current (A). low_voltage_load_power has width 3 in this order: lamp, heater, and avionics power (W). All logs must arise from the same simulation. Keep voltages, currents, charge, distance, and time finite; show nonzero motor demand and switched auxiliary-load activity; and retain connected flight-cycle, aerodynamic, mechanical, high-voltage electrical, and low-voltage distribution mechanisms. Save the completed model as cand_XAERO07.slx in the submission directory and keep the latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XAERO07.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
